description: This file contains utility functions and constants for managing graph structures, flow building, variable handling, and session memory in a flow-based application. It also imports various external modules and project-specific entities, indicating its role in core logic and integrations.

methods.name: getUserHome
methods.description: Returns the user's home directory path, falling back to current working directory if not found.

methods.name: getNodeModulesPackagePath
methods.description: Locates the path of a specified node module package by checking common node_modules directories.

methods.name: constructGraphs
methods.description: Builds graph and dependency structures from flow nodes and edges, with options for reversed or non-directed graphs.

methods.name: getStartingNode
methods.description: Identifies nodes with no dependencies as starting points in the flow.

methods.name: getStartingNodes
methods.description: Finds all starting nodes in a directed acyclic graph relative to an end node, calculating depths.

methods.name: getAllConnectedNodes
methods.description: Retrieves all nodes connected to a start node within a directed graph.

methods.name: getEndingNodes
methods.description: Determines terminal nodes in the flow, verifying their validity as ending points.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Extracts filename from a base64 string or storage URI.

methods.name: saveUpsertFlowData
methods.description: Stores or updates flow data associated with a node, including handling file references.

methods.name: checkIfDocLoaderShouldBeIgnored
methods.description: Decides whether to skip document loader nodes based on their connection to vector stores.

methods.name: buildFlow
methods.description: Constructs and executes a flow from start to end nodes, managing node initialization, variable resolution, and routing.

methods.name: clearSessionMemory
methods.description: Clears chat/session memory for nodes related to memory or assistant types.

methods.name: getGlobalVariable
methods.description: Retrieves global variables, applying overrides and environment variable substitutions.

methods.name: getVariableValue
methods.description: Resolves variable values from output responses, handling nested and special characters.
